task: Refactor the Restaurant rival from one active customer order to up to two, behind a maxActiveOrders option that defaults to 1
requirements: createRestaurantRival accepts maxActiveOrders (default 1). With the default, behaviour is byte-for-byte the same as today and every existing test in rival.test.mjs passes unchanged.

Internal single `task` becomes an ordered list of active orders, each {customer, food, targetPosition}. A single `activity` describes the one physical thing the body is doing and names which order it serves.

The rival claims a second customer only from the watchingBelt state when no matching dish for any active order is reachable. It never claims a second customer while walking to a dish, carrying, or delivering.
The rival never re-targets mid-walk: once walking to claim customer B, a matching dish for order A does not interrupt it. Existing abandon rules still apply.
targetMatchingDish considers dishes matching ANY active order and picks the earliest achievable interception, not FIFO.
Exactly one carried dish at a time. A carried dish is delivered to the order whose food it matches.
Serving one order leaves the other active; the freed slot allows a later claim.
Per-order loss handling: a lost or departed customer abandons only that order, not the whole list.
The existing claimLimit (round(total * share)) still caps total claims for the shift and is unchanged.
Expose observable state for acceptance: activeOrders (array of customer ids), maxActiveOrders, and keep targetCustomer/targetDishId/carriedDish/claims/state working.
constraints: Do not change claims.js ownership rules. A player-reserved or player-owned customer can never be claimed.
Do not raise the rival share or otherwise change Round 1 or Round 2 tuning.
No teleporting, no instant belt claiming, no invisible inventory: every pickup and delivery keeps its existing physical walk and event.
Keep the module pure: no scene, DOM or three.js references.
Preserve the existing event vocabulary and payload shapes.
Edit source with structured editing tools, never with shell regex rewrites.
